senses.gloss: [to run to and fro, wander;] (with אחר) to run after, (with מאחרי) to run away from; esp. to run about as a prostitute, to be faithless, be unchaste (cmp. ch. נפקת ברא for זוֹנָה, a. טעי for our w.).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 55b:9">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>פ̇ח̇ז̇</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:4">Gen. XLIX, 4</cite>) <he>פ̇סעת … ח̇טאת זָ֗נִיתָ</he> thou hast trespassed upon religion, sinned, been unchaste (v. <cite ref="G00174"><he>זוּל</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 100b:5">Snh. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא תִזְנֶה</he> lest she may go astray (be seduced); a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Gittin 6b">Gitt. 6ᵇ</cite> explain. <he>ותזנה עליו</he>, <cite ref="Judges 19:2">Jud. XIX, 2</cite>, cmp. Targ. a. l.

senses.gloss: same, also to invite faithlessness, to excite the senses.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 88b:2">Sabb. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>עלובה כלה מְזַנָּה בתוך חופתה</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) bold is the bride who thinks of faithlessness while getting married; <cite ref="Gittin 36b:11">Gitt. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>שזִינְּתָה בקרב וכ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Sotah 10a:7">Sot. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>כל המְזַנֶּה … מְזַנֶּנֶת עליו</he> if a man is lewd, his wife will think of faithlessness against him; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 918">Yalk. Job 918</cite> <he>מְזַנָּה תחתיו</he>.
Meg. 15ᵃ רחב בשמה זִינְּתָה וכ׳ Raḥab suggested impure thoughts by her name (Raḥab hazzonah), Jael with her call (Jud. IV, 18) &c., v. זְכִירָה; a. fr.—Trnsf. (of plants) to degenerate.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28">Gen. R. s. 28</cite>, end <he>אף הארץ זינתה</he> the earth, too, became degenerated in her produces; v. <cite ref="G00201"><he>זוֹנַיָּיא</he></cite>. Y. Kil. I, beg. 26ᵈ <he>הפירות מְזַנִּין</he> the produces may degenerate (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:29">Lev. XIX, 29</cite>).
